scope: User-requested stop and aggressive cleanup of COMET-owned Insomnia storage. Resource/model removal is recorded separately.

categories: canceled incomplete pilot and local raw prefixes
redundant launch inputs and local Git bundles
archived run/validation copies and old logs
exclusive package, compile and test caches

preservation.notes: Completed useful outcomes remain in the two verified archives. Obsolete binaries and canceled working copies retain compact measurements, identities and hashes only; no canceled raw trajectories were reintroduced.

final_verification.remaining_size_measurement: The bounded 60-second size walk timed out; no space-reclamation claim is inferred from it. Explicit scope absence and protected data presence were verified.

accounting: Byte totals are logical file sizes, not measured physical quota reclaimed. They exclude the other agent's runtime/model totals and must not be added to overlapping inventory counts.
